persona: 45-year-old IFMGA guide from Grindelwald, Eiger N face x3, buys tees off duty

designs.why: From 3 m it reads as a mountain at night. The moonlit west flank against the dark face is striking, and the headlamp pairs are a nice touch that a climber will spot. It is more generic pyramid than the Eiger though: the Eiger from Scheidegg is a huge wall with the Mittellegi ridge and a broad shoulder, and this face looks narrow and the summit too pointed. The ragged horizontal streaks on the right and the broken dashes on the face look a bit like glitch.
designs.fix: Make the silhouette more recognisably Eiger (wider north wall, clearer left ridge and shoulder) and tidy the ragged right-hand line ends into a cleaner vignette.
